MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

2. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 22
   C. 55
   D. 16

5. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 64
   C. 9
   D. 8

6. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 25
   C. 19.7
   D. 19.6

7. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

8. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 6
   C. 7
   D. 18

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 30
   C. 20
   D. 75

10. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

11. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 33
   C. 27.6
   D. 27.7

12. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/2
   D. They are equal

13. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

14. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

15. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/3

16. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

17. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 29
   C. 23.7
   D. 23

18. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.025
   D. 0.205

19. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

20. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 21
   C. 15.7
   D. 15.6

21. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x = 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x < 5

22. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/4

23. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 50
   C. 11
   D. 100

24. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 19
   C. 22
   D. 88

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
